For changes on failureType setting, see CR#1666, Miscellaneous ASN.1 review corrections."},{"tdocNumber":"R2-2206791","reason":"Ensure support for IAB Rel-17 by making necessary changes to the NR MAC specification, in line with the WI Exception Sheet.","summary":"(Rev 0) - Initial draft of a subset of outstanding MAC CEs, submitted to RAN2#118-e as starting point for discussion. (Rev 1) - Following agreements made in RAN2#118-e and in [Post118-e][065][eIAB] MAC (Samsung) discussion, outstanding MAC CEs are added in line with the WI Exception Sheet (RP-220519) and reply-LS from RAN1 in R2-2206469, as well as the LS from RAN1 containing relevant parameters in R2-2203749."},{"tdocNumber":"R2-2006181","reason":"According to agreed RRC CR (R2-2002102) in RAN2 #109e, ra-PrioritizationForAccessIdentity is added in RACH-ConfigCommon. According to the cover sheet of agreed CR (R2-2002102) the intention is to configure ra-PrioritizationForAccessIdentity in SIB 1 i.e. in RACH-ConfigCommon of initial UL BWP only. This should be clarified in specification. Additionally, RACH prioritization parameters included in ra-PrioritizationForAccessIdentity are applicable for SpCell only as CBRA is not supported for SCell.","summary":"Clarified that ra-PrioritizationForAccessIdentity is configured in RACH-ConfigCommon and RACH-ConfigCommonTwoStepRA of only initial UL BWP. If configured, it is applied for prioritized random access procedure on any UL BWP of SpCell. Clarified that ra-PrioritizationForAccessIdentity is configured in RACH-ConfigCommonTwoStepRA of only initial UL BWP. If configured, it is applied for prioritized random access procedure on any UL BWP of SpCell."},{"tdocNumber":"R2-1809299","reason":"Cover all agreements related to inter-RAT handover from RAN2#101 meeting.","summary":"Add the text of inter-RAT handover in 9.3.1.2 and 9.3.2.2 based on agreements."},{"tdocNumber":"R2-2002405","reason":"Ensure support for IAB by making necessary changes to the NR MAC specification.","summary":"(Rev 1) Added definitions of IAB node, IAB donor, and NR backhaul link (from 38.300) Introduced the extended LCID space into the spec, based on RAN2#107-Bis agreements, mainly by reusing relevant text (and approach) from 36.321 Clarified the scope of this extension using a NOTE Highlighted FFSs (in Editor’s Notes) required to be resolved for this extension to be implementable (Rev 2) Implemented agreement stating that 33 (dec) shall be used to indicate use of eLCID, both on UL and DL The final value may be changed by the NR MAC spec rapporteur depending on the reserved values used by other Rel-16 WIs and any potential clashes; if different value is chosen by MAC rapporteur, we prefer that as a minimum the same value is used for UL and DL if possible Added a NOTE specifying code points (binary) for the eLCID space (i.e. the mapping of code points to indices) 128 values in the top of the eLCID space have been set aside as reserved Introduced T_delta MAC CE and the relevant LCID value to identify this MAC CE Introduced pre-emptive BSR, the events/conditions that may trigger it, explained what the content of the relevant MAC CE indicates, and which LCID value is used to identify this MAC CE (Rev 3) Corrected typos in the cover sheet (unticked ‘Core Network’, ticked ‘ME’, and corrected revision numbers – they used to start at 0) (Rev 4) Implemented agreements from RAN2#109-e, based on R2-2002162 and R2-2002163, with modifications made by the Chair and captured in the meeting notes. (Rev 5) Changed Guard Symbol MAC CEs to move all reserved bits into a contiguous block at the start of the MAC CE. Restructured SR triggering so that pre-emptive BSR and non-pre-emptive BSR are at the same indentation level (no changes to intended functionality). Updated eLCID index values according to agreements made in the overall LCID Rel-16 discussions."}],"abstain":false,"complete":true}
